- How to advertise it:
  - “Outdoor composting workshop at [Garden Name] – Primary date Sunday Dec 14, 2–4 p.m., with weather backup Sunday Dec 7, 2–4 p.m.”
  - Note: “This is an outdoor event; please dress warmly. In case of heavy rain, snow, or icy conditions, we’ll move to the backup date. Final call will be made by 10 a.m. on the primary date and announced by email/text.”

- How composting works (the basics of browns, greens, air, and moisture)  
- Different composting systems that work well in community gardens and backyards  
- How to build or refresh a compost pile step-by-step  
- How to troubleshoot common problems (smells, pests, slow compost, and more)
